migrations.risk: Application-integrity risk: enables exactly-two-person Project DMs with consent, retained-history, membership-churn, block-owner and immutable receipt rules. Additive columns and tables copy no message body.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable conversation sends and DM entry while retaining acknowledged messages, state receipts, task provenance and history. Do not drop acknowledged data.
postconditions: one sorted DM pair per Project remains enforced
DM request and transition receipts are durable and body-free
message, attention and outbox guards require an active consenting pair
membership loss denies the affected participant and never silently reuses consent
task receipts retain source conversation identity
